intro.text: A grieving mother in occupied Kholinar, married to Cob, whose young child was killed.

items.text: After her child died, Kheni sat silent, holding an empty cradle, though she still listened to those who spoke to her. Wit befriended her and Cob while living in disguise in the city. Before leaving, he brought them an orphaned girl to care for, and Kheni began to come back to herself.
